dtype: float32 little endian (IEEE754); values printed with 9 significant digits (exact float32 round-trip)

class_internal_codes.note: index 5 = double_tap (not a network output); reported pose = 0x6F07C[index] = index

input.order: frame k=0 (newest) .. 4 (oldest, nominally t-20); each frame = [rms_norm_oriented[0..7], mpf_oriented[0..7]] standardized; see spec for the ring gather bug

normalization.formula: z[i] = (f[i] - mean[i]) / std[i]  (float32 sub then float32 div)

network.layer_struct: 32 bytes: u8 type(0 dense,1 prelu,2 softmax), i32 in, i32 out, f32* bias, f32* weights, f32* in_buf, f32* out_buf, f32* prelu_alpha
network.dense_formula: y[o] = (sum_{i=0..in-1} W[o][i]*x[i], accumulated in order from i=0 starting at 0.0f, separate multiply and add roundings) + b[o]
network.prelu: y = x > 0 ? x : alpha*x; alpha pointers 0x2000840C, 0x20008510, 0x20008A68 are in .bss and never written -> alpha = 0.0 (ReLU)
network.softmax: m = max(x); e[i] = expf(x[i]-m); s = sum e (in order); p[i] = e[i]/s
network.decision: best = 0.5f, cls = 0; for i in 0..4: if p[i] > best { best = p[i]; cls = i }
